title: Can you choose the right trigger?

questions.prompt: Which trigger best fits checks that should update while a proposed change evolves?
questions.explanation: The pull_request event follows activity on a proposed change and can report checks on that pull request.

questions.prompt: An operator should choose staging or production when starting deployment. Which trigger fits best?
questions.explanation: workflow_dispatch supports an operator-started run and declared inputs such as the target environment.

questions.prompt: No workflow run exists for a documentation-only pull request. Which checks belong first? Select all that apply.

options.label: Whether the on block includes the actual event
Whether path filters include the changed files
Whether the workflow file and YAML are valid
The output of a test step that never ran

questions.explanation: When no run exists, investigate trigger selection, filters, file placement, and YAML validity before job or step details.

questions.prompt: Order these checks from earliest to latest in the workflow lifecycle.

options.label: Confirm that the event created a run

questions.explanation: A job cannot schedule until a run exists, and a step cannot fail until its job begins.

questions.prompt: Design triggers for a repository that should test pull requests, test commits after they reach main, and let an operator start a staging deployment.
questions.rubric: Credit answers that choose pull_request for proposed changes, a push trigger filtered to main for landed commits, and workflow_dispatch with a staging input or staging-specific workflow for the operator action.
questions.reference_answer: Use pull_request for the change checks. Add push with branches: [main] for commits that land on main. Define deployment with workflow_dispatch and a constrained environment input that includes staging.
questions.explanation: Each trigger should match the actor and timing of the work instead of forcing unrelated events into one pattern.

questions.prompt: Which filters can narrow when a repository event creates a run? Select all that apply.

options.label: Text found in a runner log

questions.explanation: Branch, path, tag, and activity filters affect event matching. Runner logs exist only after a run and job begin.

questions.prompt: Use {{pull-request-trigger}} to test a proposed change and {{manual-trigger}} when an operator should start a run. If no run exists, inspect {{event-filters}} before runner logs.

options.label: the on block and its filters

questions.explanation: Pull requests fit proposed-change checks, workflow_dispatch fits operator starts, and missing runs are trigger or filter problems.
